question: How can players migrate their progress from PC to mobile in Vectaria.io?

On your mobile device, log in with the same account and select 'Sync Progress' again to download your data. For example, if you have unlocked the 'Elite Sniper' skin on PC, it will be available on your mobile account after syncing.
